title: Civil Project Engineer
rationale: Rockhampton sits within Central Queensland, an area Marc has explicitly said he is available for FIFO and project-site work.
The role calls for CPEng/RPEQ (or working towards) and ideally 5 years' experience in project delivery on mid-to-large civil projects, both well beyond Marc's current stage.
Discipline overlap on rail infrastructure project delivery is moderate rather than a close match to Marc's road/drainage/documentation background.
caution: Rough fit, not an interview forecast; the stated 5 years' experience requirement is the clear blocker.
gaps: Whether Aurizon has a graduate or trainee project engineer pathway instead
